title: The Crazy Nastyass Honey Badger (original narration by Randall)
summary: A viral nature-documentary parody in which a narrator gives a profane, deadpan commentary over footage of a honey badger attacking snakes, including a cobra bite and recovery. It became the source of the 'honey badger don't care' meme.
why: Cited purely as a joke or meme whenever a thread touches on fearlessness, persistence or honey badgers.
